paper_title: Short-range spin-dependent interactions of electrons: a probe for exotic pseudo-Goldstone bosons
coupling_convention: (g_p^e)^2/(hbar*c), dimensionless squared electron pseudoscalar coupling, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 4 (bottom)
notes: Torsion-pendulum/rotating-attractor search for exotic dipole-dipole (Vdd) and monopole-dipole (Vmd) interactions of electrons. Paper presents TWO new laboratory limits: (1) dipole-dipole electron pseudoscalar coupling, with (g_p^e)^2/hbar-c constrained at the 5.5e-17 level for m_b < 30 ueV (extending with weaker sensitivity up to m_b <= 500 ueV, F > 70 TeV); (2) CP-violating monopole-dipole limits |g_p^e g_s^N|/hbar-c ~ 1e-28 level for 1.5-400 ueV (MonopoleDipole type, Fig. 5, not extracted here). Following the pre-analysis hint I extracted the AxionElectron (dipole-dipole) bound. Only the single flat text value for m_b < 30 ueV is quoted numerically; the full mass-dependent exclusion is in Fig. 4 (not numerically readable). Bound encoded as flat line from ~0 up to 3e-5 eV. 2-sigma (95% CL) exclusion. Note: this is g_ae^2 appearing in the potential normalized by hbar-c; if downstream expects 4*pi normalization, adjust accordingly. Not a dark-matter haloscope, so no DM density assumption. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.7, 45)) | Vision: Fig. 4 bottom panel: dipole-dipole exclusion on (g_p^e)^2/hbar-c vs m_b. Flat floor at 5.5e-17 for m_b < 30 ueV is explicitly quoted in the text (2-sigma). The high-mass rise was traced from the plot and cross-checked with the expected Yukawa suppression e^{r/lambda}/(1+r/lambda+(r/lambda)^2/3) at effective separation ~5 mm (s=4.12 mm), which matches the plotted curve reaching the top of the yellow region near 600-700 ueV. Note the y-axis is the SQUARED coupling divided by hbar*c, not canonical g_ae; values are emitted exactly as plotted per the plotted-values contract. Excluded region is above the curve; limits are at 2-sigma (95% CL).
